summary: Seattle, software developer, strong interest in programming languages and paradigms, advocates for basic income, studied Lojban and conlangs, enjoys text-based MUDs and interactive fiction, has a technical background in C#, JavaScript, and TypeScript, engages in discussions about open-source software and web standards, critical of hackathon culture, interested in the intersection of technology and social issues, has a nuanced view on economic theories, particularly Modern Monetary Theory, and expresses skepticism towards traditional employment structures.
